title: Senior Backend Engineer
description: p strong Description /strong /p p Equal Experts is an innovative consultancy specializing in the delivery of custom software solutions for blue-chip enterprise and public sector clients across a range of industry sectors. We work on important projects for our clients, deliver market-leading propositions across the digital, online and mobile channels, and are recognized for our leadership in the application of agile and lean delivery methods to assure delivery. We have offices in Australia, India, South Africa, the UK, the EU and the USA. nbsp; /p p We’re seeking backend engineers with proven senior-level experience to join the Equal Experts network on a permanent basis. nbsp; /p p As a member of the team you will work alongside our clients to help design and deliver solutions to meet business requirements and help to improve the effectiveness of the clients' software delivery capability. And of course, all this happens in a consultative, collaborative fashion – in keeping with our values. nbsp; /p p You should have extensive experience delivering software on commercial projects backed up by extensive knowledge of agile practices such as TDD, pair programming and CI/CD to name a few. nbsp; /p p A growth-based, learning mindset is a must coupled with a passion for technology. nbsp; /p p This role involves working in teams that use modern agile technical practices - including continuous integration and deployment and fast feedback loops - to deliver timely and pragmatic solutions, as well as helping others to do their jobs in a more effective way. /p p nbsp; /p p strong Responsibilities nbsp; /strong /p ul li Working with the client and the team to determine system requirements and how best to deliver them. nbsp; /li li Delivery of software using agile (pair programming, TDD, CI/CD, etc) practices nbsp; /li li Automation of system infrastructure and deployments. nbsp; /li li Production support of systems you are working on (You build it, you run it). nbsp; /li li Advocating agile practices to the client organisation. nbsp; /li li Mentoring client team members. nbsp; /li li Helping improve the team and clients’ delivery capabilities. nbsp; /li /ul p nbsp; /p p strong Required Skills nbsp; /strong /p ul li Extensive, diversified experience developing, maintaining and operating enterprise scale distributed systems. /li li Expert level knowledge of your chosen programming language and the associated tooling. Experience with other languages is highly desirable. /li li Hands-on experience with test driven development and other forms of automated testing. /li li Strong understanding of the principles underlying agile development and an understanding of the various approaches that can be effective in realising these principles in different contexts. /li li Strong communication skills, including the ability to communicate effectively while working remotely with globally distributed teams. /li li Strong interpersonal skills, including a desire to collaborate and share knowledge with other team members, including client team members. This also includes the ability to work collectively towards a common goal without insisting on a given course of action. /li /ul p strong Nice To Have nbsp; /strong /p ul li Hands-on experience developing distributed systems including microservice architectures and RESTful services. /li li Hands-on experience developing and running large scale production systems ideally in containerised/cloud environments using either AWS, GCP or Azure. /li /ul

title: Staff Software Engineer, Security Foundations
description: div class= content-intro p GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster. /p p The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values nbsp;and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. a href= https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI Co-create the future with us /a as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software. /p p * em Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab. /em /p /div h1 strong style= font-size: 14px; An overview of this role /strong /h1 p As a Staff Software Engineer, you'll help lead two important areas for GitLab Security: the data layer behind our vulnerability and dependency management capabilities, and our move toward services outside the GitLab monolith. You'll design and develop systems that ingest, store, index, and query security report data, including integrations with key third-party systems. With a strong focus on PostgreSQL and scalable backend design, your work will support security features delivered by teams across GitLab. /p p You'll take ownership of large deliverables from early ideas through implementation, working directly with product, design, frontend, and engineering partners to shape the technical and product roadmap. You'll stay hands-on across GitLab's Ruby on Rails application and newer services, including greenfield projects, while helping the team build its expertise in modular service design. /p p strong What you’ll do /strong /p ul li Lead large technical deliverables from initial problem definition through delivery, often across multiple months or quarters. /li li Design and develop backend systems for vulnerability and dependency management, including security report ingestion, storage, indexing, querying, and integrations with key third-party systems. /li li Build and improve systems using Ruby on Rails and PostgreSQL, and contribute to newer services using technologies such as Go or Rust where appropriate. /li li Shape technical plans, break down complex work, and help other engineers deliver effectively. /li li Work directly with product, design, frontend, and engineering partners to make clear decisions, resolve constraints, and deliver measurable progress. /li li Influence the team's product and technical roadmap through hands-on investigation, clear proposals, and iterative delivery that demonstrates progress in each monthly release cycle. /li li Apply a security mindset when designing systems, including considering how GitLab identifies and handles malicious or vulnerable software packages. /li li Define patterns for modular services, provide technical leadership when vulnerability management work spans multiple GitLab areas, and share that expertise across GitLab Security. /li /ul p strong What you’ll bring /strong /p ul li Experience leading complex backend projects from idea through delivery while remaining hands-on with design and development. /li li Strong PostgreSQL experience, including evidence of query optimization, table optimization, and write-ahead log management in data-intensive systems. /li li Strong professional experience with Ruby on Rails or nbsp; Go and comfort working in Ruby on Rails day to day. Experience with large monoliths is helpful, along with an interest in working across languages and services. /li li Experience shaping delivery plans, guiding technical decisions, and supporting the work of other engineers. /li li The ability to collaborate with a range of partners and explain technical trade-offs clearly. /li li Experience communicating with leaders, leading peers through complex delivery, identifying constraints, and moving work forward. /li li Experience using security tooling for activities such as vulnerability triage and remediation, or professional experience building vulnerability management, dependency management, or related security products. /li li Experience with large-scale data systems or established software products. We welcome transferable experience from outside the security domain. /li li Fluency in using artificial intelligence tools to improve delivery while applying sound engineering judgment. /li /ul p nbsp; /p p strong About the team /strong /p p The Vulnerability Management team contributes to GitLab's move toward modular services and will help other Security teams adopt these patterns over time. Today, we include two Staff Software Engineers, two Senior Software Engineers, and one Intermediate Software Engineer across the United Kingdom, Poland, the Netherlands, and India. You'll work closely with us, product partners, and engineering leaders across GitLab. /p p We work with clear goals and shared priorities. You'll receive clear context and outcomes, then have the space to own delivery, communicate decisions and progress, ask for help early, and work directly with the partners needed to get the job done. /p div class= content-conclusion h4 strong How GitLab Supports Full-Time E
